name: Afraid Owl 82
author: sherghan7
description: Dark black button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes #EEEEEE 0px 0px 0px 11px, #161616 0px 0px 0px 10px, background changes from #000 to #000, text color changes from #EEEEEE to #EEEEEE.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Afraid Owl 82</title>
<style>
/* Afraid Owl 82 by sherghan7 — https://uiverse.io/sherghan7/afraid-owl-82 */
button {
  min-width: 120px;
  background: #000;
  color: #EEEEEE;
  height: 40px;
  margin: 10px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

button:hover {
  box-shadow: #EEEEEE 0px 0px 0px 11px, #161616 0px 0px 0px 10px;
  background: #000;
  color: #EEEEEE;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
